ledger: 00:00 - White aerodynamic semi-truck cab parked outside the diner
01:41 - Dark green classic box truck parked outside the diner

findings.description: The parked truck outside the diner appears as a modern white aerodynamic sleeper-cab semi-truck in the opening establishing shot (00:00–00:09), but when the driver walks out to his truck at 01:41, it has changed into a dark green classic conventional-style box truck.
